component.name: Open Music Player
component.summary: A native home for music, podcasts, and radio

description.p: Listen to local music, subscribe to podcasts, discover internet radio, and keep your queue close with a compact player and desktop media controls.
Fix the missing duration-column clock icon across desktop icon themes.
Simplify Settings by removing redundant explanatory text and clean up unused translations across all ten interface languages.
Bundle sidebar and queue icons for consistent display across desktop themes, and use the Open Music Player logo in the system tray.
First public packaged release, with verified Linux packages, an AppImage runtime, and user and data privacy guides.
